subject: MAP proposal: Procurement + legal gating for Synthetix Health pilot
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@synthetix.health>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@synthetix.health>, Legal Ops <legal.ops@synthetix.health>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: procurement + legal gating for pilot

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to move into a 30-day pilot. Procurement and Legal asked I pull together a Mutual Action Plan so we have clear gating on the MSA/DPA/order form, plus acceptance milestones for the trial. Rough asks from our side:

- Target pilot start: Nov 16, 2026
- Signature window: ideally by Nov 30 so we can onboard infra for the pilot
- Key docs needed: executed MSA, DPA, and signed order form with trial terms
- Security checklist (SOC2 evidence + data handling Qs)

Can your team propose a MAP with owners, target dates, and which items are blockers vs parallel work? We need something we can align Legal + Procurement against.

Appreciate it — Alex

[Attachment: Synthetix_initial_requirements.docx (2 pages)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@synthetix.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: procurement + legal gating for pilot

Hi Alex — thanks, this is great context. I attached a first-cut MAP (spreadsheet) that splits work into three lanes: Legal (MSA/DPA redlines), Procurement (PO/PO terms + order form), and Technical Onboarding (pilot config + acceptance tests). High-level plan:

- 11/02: Redwood sends MAP draft with owners (attached)
- 11/05: Karthik to circulate MSA redlines (legal lane)
- 11/08: Procurement to confirm order form economics and PO process
- 11/12: Security evidence (SOC2 summary + answers to questionnaire)
- 11/16: Pilot starts (soft launch) — conditional on order form signed or signed order form pending with PO raise
- 11/30: Target executed MSA/DPA + order form (final signature)

Blockers to call out up-front: any needed contract deviations (data residency, indemnities) and SOC2 scope items that require security team review. If Legal needs more time on the MSA redline velocity, we can stagger onboarding (embedded tokenization disabled until DPA is complete) but we'd prefer all signatures before production traffic.

Attached: Synthetix_MAP_draft.xlsx (sheet: ownership + gating), acceptance-criteria section filled.

Karthik / Marissa / Vanessa — can you confirm owners and whether the signature target of 11/30 looks feasible? If Procurement needs an earlier PO milestone to allow onboarding on 11/16, flag that and we’ll add a conditional acceptance lane.

Best,
Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Synthetix_MAP_draft.xlsx (5 rows)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@synthetix.health>
Date: 2026-11-05T14:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: procurement + legal gating for pilot

On Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 2:04 PM Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached: Synthetix_MAP_draft.xlsx (sheet: ownership + gating)

Thanks — reviewed the MAP. Two quick notes from Legal:

1) Redline velocity: I can push a first-pass redline to Alex by 11/08 but will need procurement confirmation of the order form economics before finalizing risk allocation clauses tied to fees. If we get the order form by 11/06, Legal can aim to finish redlines by 11/11.

2) DPA: We have a standard DPA; Synthetix has requested additional data residency language in Section 4. Legal would need the requested wording to be explicit (region + subprocessor constraints) — otherwise we'll keep to the standard DPA and note the change in the MAP as a blocker.

I'll attach the working redline (MSA) and mark clauses that will need exec-level sign-off (indemnity caps, residuals). If those are material, that will push signature beyond 11/30.

Karthik

[Attachment: redlines_MSA_v1.docx (comments + tracked changes)]

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@synthetix.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@synthetix.health>, Legal Ops <legal.ops@synthetix.health>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: procurement + legal gating for pilot

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Karthik. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Procurement needs an interim PO approval by 11/12 (not necessarily a fully executed order form) to schedule cloud infra and SSO config. Can Redwood accept a conditional PO + order form signature to enable technical onboarding?
- Security: Legal Ops asked for SOC2 Type II summary + answers to the attached security questionnaire by 11/12. They will triage any open items; major issues will be blockers for production only.

If Redwood can accept a conditional PO approach (PO + countersign later), that will keep the 11/16 pilot start intact while Legal and Finance complete final signatures.

Also: please provide a short readout (one page) of acceptance criteria for the pilot that Procurement can attach to the internal PO.

Thanks — Alex

[Attachment: Synthetix_Security_RQ.docx (20 questions)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@synthetix.health>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Legal Ops <legal.ops@synthetix.health>, Procurement <procurement@synthetix.health>
Date: 2026-11-12T15:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: procurement + legal gating for pilot — finalized timeline + next steps

Thanks everyone — quick status and next actions (finalized MAP attached as PDF):

Status:
- Redwood provided one-page acceptance criteria and onboarding runbook (attached).
- Legal provided MSA redlines (Karthik) and called out data residency ask as a blocker pending explicit language from Synthetix.
- Procurement confirmed they can issue a conditional PO by 11/12 to enable infra provisioning; internal PO owner: Jenna Mills (procurement@synthetix.health).
- Security questionnaire received; Redwood will return answers by 11/15.

Finalized timeline (MAP lanes):
- 11/12: Conditional PO issued (Procurement) — TECH can begin infra provisioning
- 11/15: Redwood returns Security questionnaire answers + SOC2 summary
- 11/16: Pilot soft-launch (no production traffic)
- 11/20: Legal targets MSA redline finalization for exec review (if Synthetix confirms residency wording by 11/18)
- 11/30: Target executed MSA/DPA + order form (final signatures)

Owners:
- Legal owner: Karthik Iyer (redlines)
- Procurement owner: Jenna Mills (Synthetix) + Marissa Cole (Redwood billing/order form)
- Technical onboarding: Vanessa Ortiz
- Pilot acceptance: Sofia Ivanova (success)

Open items / risks:
- Data residency clause unresolved — Synthetix to provide exact language by 11/18 or signature moves past 11/30.
- Any exec-level indemnity/cap changes will push timelines; flag early if requested.

Next steps:
1) Alex / Legal Ops: share the exact residency language (if any) by 11/18.
2) Redwood: deliver security questionnaire responses by 11/15 and upload SOC2 summary to the shared Drive link.
3) Procurement: issue conditional PO by 11/12 and confirm Jenna Mills as PO owner on the HubSpot deal.

Attaching: MAP_final_timeline.pdf and one-pager acceptance criteria. Will update HubSpot (link below) with MAP and owners.

Best,
Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: MAP_final_timeline.pdf, acceptance_onepager.pdf]
